description:
Sycamore Lodge is a beautifully presented detached dormer bungalow tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac just off Booterstown Avenue, enjoying a highly sought-after and convenient location. Occupying a mature and private setting with a west-facing garden, it offers exceptionally bright and versatile accommodation throughout. 

Extending to approximately 243 sq. metres/2616 sq. feet and presented in turnkey condition throughout, this impressive residence seamlessly combines elegant reception rooms, generous bedroom accommodation and superb family living spaces, creating a home of genuine quality and comfort. Suitable for families, professionals and right-sizers alike, the property enjoys a wonderful balance of flexibility, practicality and style, all set within beautifully maintained gardens.

A welcoming entrance hall provides an immediate sense of space and warmth, enhanced by quality finishes and excellent natural light. To the right, an elegant living room overlooks the front garden and is centred around a contemporary feature fireplace with bespoke fitted shelving, creating a stylish yet comfortable setting for both everyday living and entertaining. To the rear, the home opens into an exceptional kitchen and dining room, positioned as the heart of the house. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of contemporary cabinetry complemented by generous work surfaces, integrated appliances and a substantial central island providing additional preparation space, storage and casual dining. The adjoining dining area enjoys an abundance of natural light, enhanced by two large rooflights and extensive glazing overlooking the sunny rear garden. French doors open directly onto the patio, creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces and making this an ideal environment for family life and entertaining. A separate family room further enhances the versatility of the accommodation, providing an additional reception space suited to a variety of uses including a television room, playroom or informal living area. A generously proportioned utility room offers extensive built-in storage, ample worktop space, plumbed laundry facilities and direct external access, while a separate boiler room provides further practical storage.

The bedroom accommodation is exceptionally flexible and well-balanced. On the ground floor there are three spacious bedrooms, one of which benefits from an ensuite shower room, while another is currently laid out as a study. A large family bathroom, finished to a high standard with quality tiling, contemporary sanitary ware, bath and heated towel rail, serves the remaining ground-floor accommodation. At first-floor level, a bright gallery landing incorporates a dedicated home office area with bespoke desk space and shelving, ideally suited to modern remote working requirements. There are two particularly generous double bedrooms on this level, both benefitting from ensuite bathrooms and extensive fitted wardrobe accommodation.

Outside, the gardens are a particular feature of the property. Mature hedging established planting and specimen trees create a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion. Extensive paved patio areas immediately adjoining the house provide excellent outdoor entertaining space, while the large lawn offers ample space for family activities. There is also an additional storage room providing valuable space for bikes and garden equipment. To the front, a generous driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Combining generous proportions, flexible accommodation and beautifully maintained gardens, this outstanding detached residence represents a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey family home of exceptional quality in a highly desirable residential setting.

Booterstown Avenue is widely regarded as one of South County Dublin’s most desirable residential addresses, prized for its unique blend of coastal charm and urban convenience. The property enjoys close proximity to the DART and Quality Bus Corridor, ensuring swift access to the city centre, while nearby amenities include an array of renowned schools, UCD’s Belfield and Carysfort campuses and a selection of churches. Dublin’s premier shopping centres are within easy reach, and the nearby Booterstown Strand and bird sanctuary provide a beautiful natural backdrop, enhancing the exceptional lifestyle on offer.
